# Hikaya by Maison Jaber

> Hikaya by Maison Jaber makes personalised children's storybooks in English and Arabic. Parents choose a story, add their child's first name, age and one photo, and the child is illustrated as the hero of a printed hardcover book (21×21 cm), gift-boxed and delivered across the UAE and the GCC (Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman). Operated by Maison Jaber FZ-LLC, UAE. Arabic name: حكاية من ميزون جابر.

Key facts:
- Ages: stories written for 2–4, 4–6 and 6–8 years.
- Languages: every story is available as an Arabic or English edition; Arabic editions have their own covers and read right to left.
- Price: AED 169 per book (shown in local currency in each GCC country); 2 books save 10% and 3 or more save 15%, with free delivery.
- Delivery: free across the UAE; about 5 working days to the UAE, about 7 to the rest of the GCC. Every book arrives in gift packaging and can be sent directly to the child.
- Personalisation: the child's name and likeness, plus an optional message on the first page; some stories let parents add a photo of a parent or grandparent too.
- Privacy: uploaded photos are used only to make the book and are deleted after 15 days.
- Contact: hello@maison-jaber.com, WhatsApp +971 50 801 1769. Instagram @hikaya.mj, TikTok @hikaya073.
